{{Quote|Are we going too far? The war is popular in my sector. We would be seen by many as obstructing an inevitable victory.|Terr Taneel to members of the Delegation of 2,000|<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>}}
'''Terr Taneel''' was a [[human]] [[senator]] for the [[Senex sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. She was a member of the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group who worried that [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] would not relinquish his [[Emergency Powers Act|emergency powers]] at the end of the war.

Along with other members of the group, she attended talks at [[Cantham House]], the private estate of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], where the wording of the planned [[Petition of 2,000]] was discussed. Taneel worried that they might be going to far when it was suggested they demand that Palpatine open peace talks to end the conflict.

When Palpatine was kidnapped and the rescued during the [[Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY]], Taneel was part of a crowd of senators that greeted him upon his return to Coruscant. She then attenended the [[Galaxies Opera House]] shortly before the petition was presented in the senate and the Clone Wars came to an end with Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclaiming]] himself [[Galactic Emperor]].

==Biography==
===Hesitant delegate===
[[File:Delegation_of_2000_meeting.png|thumb|right|300px|Taneel attended talks at Cantham House.]]
A [[human]] from the [[planet]] [[Neelanon]]<ref name="Topps" /> Terr Taneel was a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]<ref name="BOBG" /> during the conflict against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], known as the [[Clone Wars]]. She<ref name="Topps" /> represented the [[Senex sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> and sat on a committee close to [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="Topps" /> As the war began to wind down,<ref name="BOBG" /> Taneel attended talks held at [[Cantham House]],<ref name="Rebel Files" /> the private estate of [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Leia">''[[Leia, Princess of Alderaan]]''</ref> Organa and Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] were seeking other senators who were worried that Palpatine would not relinquish his [[Emergency Powers Act|emergency powers]] at the end of the conflict.<ref name="BOBG" /> The group planned became known as the [[Delegation of 2,000]]<ref name="VE" /> and planned to provide their demands to Palpatine in the form of the [[Petition of 2,000]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

Taneel was part of a group consisting of [[Loyalist Committee]] members and other select senators including<ref name="Rebel Files" /> [[Mon Mothma]], [[Fang Zar]], and [[Giddean Danu]],<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> that Organa invited to discuss the exact wording of the petition at Cantham House. When Mothma listed their demands as the relinquishment of the emergency powers, the abolishment of the [[Sector Governance Decree]], and the beginning of peace talks with the Separatists, Taneel questioned if the peace talks were too far given how popular the war was in her [[sector]], fearing some might view them as obstructing a certain victory. Amidala then reminded Taneel of the [[death]] toll of the conflict and pointed out that the longer it lasted the more time Palpatine would have to find loopholes through which he could amend the [[Galactic Constitution|constitution]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

===War's end===
[[File:TaneelandHalliikeenovich.png|thumb|left|300px|Taneel met with a human at the Galaxies Opera House.]]
A [[Standard month|month]] after this talk<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Palpatine was kidnapped by the Separatists and then rescued by the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="ROTS" /> Taneel breathed a sigh of relief<ref name="Topps" /> and was amongst the crowd who greeted the Chancellor on one of the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building's]] landing pads when he was returned from Separatist capture by [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. As Palpatine disembarked from a [[Util-313]] [[speeder bus]], the crowd moved forward to greet him before following him back into the building.<ref name="ROTS" />

Taneel later attended the [[Galaxies Opera House]] while Palpatine was viewing a performance of the [[Mon Calamari]] ballet ''[[Squid Lake]]'' there. She was stood talking to another human in one of the [[opera]] house's corridors when Skywalker rushed past her on his way to meet with Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" /> Shortly after this, the Petition of 2,000 was presented at a full session of the Senate,<ref name="Rebel Files" /> but when the war did end soon after, Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|declared]] himself [[Galactic Emperor]] of a new [[Galactic Empire]] rather then giving up his powers.<ref name="ROTS" /> Within a [[Standard day|day]], sixty-three signatories of the petition were arrested by the Empire.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Personality and traits==
Taneel was suspicious of Palpatine during the Clone Wars and concerns about his power-grabbing caused her to join forces with Organa and his allies,<ref name="Topps" /> although she was hesitant about some of their planned demands.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> The senator had above average intelligence and diplomatic skills, but was bellow average in strength, speed, and combat skills. She was not [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Topps" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AmandaLucas-ROTS.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Amanda Lucas as Terr Taneel]]
Taneel was portrayed by director [[George Lucas]]' eldest daughter, [[Amanda Lucas]], in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]].<ref name="ROTS" /> In April [[2003]], George Lucas discussed with the costume designer [[Trisha Biggar]] the need for four female Senatorial outfits, including one for Amanda and another for her sister [[Katie Lucas|Katie]].<ref name="db">{{DB|character|terrtaneel|Taneel, Terr}}</ref> Ultimately, Katie was given the part of [[Chi Eekway Papanoida]] and Amanda the part of Terr Taneel.<ref name="ROTS" />
